entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A legendary cathar commander in a Nearheath chapel, mourning Avacyn's death; he is turned into a vampire by Henrika but keeps his soul.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar and old friend of Odric who wrote to him, and who joins the fight at the chapel against Henrika Domnathi.

entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: A Domnathi vampire who serves a demon and attacks the chapel to anoint a priest with demon blood and Avacyn's tears.

entities.name: The priest
entities.description: The chapel's priest, who abandons it after hearing of Avacyn's death and returns as Henrika's glamered servant.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon whose essence appears in the pool of blood and tears, whom Henrika serves as dealmaker, and who sinks back into oblivion.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel who is dead; her tears kept above the chapel altar are meant for the demon's anointing.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A spirit who aided Thalia in wielding Avacyn's spear before being forced out.

entities.name: Grete
entities.description: A companion of Thalia who left Odric in the chapel.

entities.name: Jerren
entities.description: A Lunarch leader among the traitors who grew uneasy at Henrika's name.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: The last archangel, who slew her sisters Bruna and Gisela.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: An archangel slain by Sigarda.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: An archangel slain by Sigarda.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: The progenitor of the Voldaren line who made a pact that no vampire would draw human blood until the war was over.

entities.name: Domnathi
entities.description: A vampire bloodline serving a demon and attacking the chapel.

entities.name: Domnathi cathar thralls
entities.description: Cathars who replaced their left hands with dead ones and now serve Ormendahl and Henrika.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: The church leadership whose corruption Thalia warned Odric about.

entities.name: Tears of Avacyn
entities.description: Divine drops of the dead angel's tears kept above the altar, used to enhance spells and heal wounds, which Henrika wants for an unholy anointing.

entities.name: Sword of Avacyn
entities.description: Odric's silver sword with Avacyn's symbol on the hilt that glows with moonlight.

entities.name: Nearheath chapel
entities.description: The small chapel of Avacyn in Nearheath where Odric stays.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city where Odric allowed horrors to pass.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane at war with demons and nightmares.

events.summary: Thalia's letter, read to Odric, tells of Avacyn's death, the fall of the archangels and a stronger evil that forced Saint Traft out of her.
Odric mourns in the chapel, regretting not believing Thalia about the Lunarch Council's corruption.
events.quote: Thalia had warned him of the Lunarch Council's corruption

events.summary: The priest announces that the wards have fallen and Avacyn is dead, then walks out undefended into the night.
Odric hacks the altar to pieces in rage.
events.quote: A moment later, he found himself hacking the altar to pieces

events.summary: A mist rolls into the chapel and enthralls the two monks, who say that the tears of Avacyn rest above the altar for Madam Henrika.
events.quote: "The tears of Avacyn rest above the altar where they can drink the light of the moon, Madam Henrika."

events.summary: Odric frees the monks of the glamour with moonlight, but cathar thralls with a dead hand kill them.
events.quote: the heavy thuds of two bodies hitting the floor boomed from the doorways

events.summary: Henrika takes shape, announces that the cathars serve Ormendahl, and the two thralls attack Odric, whom he defeats.
Odric goads Henrika, deducing she is only an errand girl for a demon, and she calls herself a dealmaker.
events.quote: "I am a dealmaker," she hissed back at him

events.summary: The priest returns bitten, bearing a devil, and Henrika says he will be first to be anointed into the demon's order.
Thalia crashes through the roof and kills cathar attackers alongside Odric.
events.quote: Thalia came down along with her and landed hard

events.summary: Twenty Domnathi vampires overrun Odric and Thalia.
events.quote: Soon they were disarmed, overwhelmed, and held at the mercy of Henrika's minions.

events.summary: The priest kills the devil over the pool of tears, and the mixture turns crimson and shows the demon's essence.
Henrika slits the throat of the glamered father and demands that Thalia serve; Thalia refuses.
events.quote: Henrika slit the throat of the father.

events.summary: Odric leaps in front of Henrika's sword to save Thalia and is mortally wounded.
events.quote: He leaped in front of the sword moments before it was to take Thalia's hand

events.summary: Henrika bites Odric and turns him into a vampire.
events.quote: she descended upon him, biting into his neck

events.summary: The Domnathi vampires explode because of the blessed water in Odric's blood; Thalia stabs Henrika, who flees as mist.
events.quote: "There is blessed water in your blood—?!"

events.summary: The vampiric Odric hurls his sword to behead the priest and break the pool, and the demon Ormendahl sinks back into oblivion.
events.quote: The blade severed the priest's head and lodged in the bowl of the pool.

events.summary: Odric finds that, as a vampire, he can still see the moon and feels peace; he and Thalia stand together.

relations.note: She serves the demon as dealmaker.
relations.quote: If such a villain as Henrika wanted them—the demon she served, moreover

relations.note: She leads the Domnathi at the chapel.
relations.quote: Domnathi is what we prefer to be called

relations.note: She turns him into a vampire.
relations.quote: "You shall serve a master," Henrika hummed.
Bruna and Gisela, who were slain by their own sister and our last archangel—Sigarda
